messages.subject: Re: Can't install DT package
parts:
You can report DT issues to https://github.com/rstudio/DT/issues

I think you have installed this package successfully. It is just a
warning, which I believe is due to your version of R is too low
(3.0.x?).

Regards,
Yihui
